name: @playform/ets-hook-dsh-workspace-audit
description: The workspace-audit hook: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that is the workspace's ACCOUNTABILITY - the event records and the ledger lines (the AUDIT role of the workspace family's invisible flow: ... -> the merge commits -> the journal records -> the audit lines -> the live view presents). The audit lines are the OutcomeEvidence on the traceability graph (the intent-model semantics, critique round 5, binding): Announcement -> Interpretation -> IntentRevision -> Commitment -> PlanRevision -> ProposedChange -> AuthorizationDecision -> ExecutionAttempt -> OutcomeEvidence -> IntentAssessment - the accountability is the graph's record, and the IntentAssessment closes the loop against the IntentSpecification's satisfaction contract. The hook records one accountability line per event into its own KV storage domain named workspace_audit and its own ledger: every line carries the operation identifier, the parent identifier, and the event category (the recursion-prevention law, DOCUMENTED IN the family map), so audit chains compose without recursion. The fs/observed listener (ROOT context) records an OutcomeEvidence line per observed write; ctx.workspaceAudit.line records any graph node's line; ctx.workspaceAudit.assessment closes the loop with an IntentAssessment line. The conversation never sees the lines until an event surfaces them (the visibility rule). The plugin ships DISABLED - the IDLE-forever posture. Plan: Documentation/Plans/Workspace-Family/AUDIT.md + Documentation/Plans/WORKSPACE-FAMILY-V4-1.md (the ten-step invisible flow, section 2 item 6).
